participation.context: Kept the names upstairs, left the chest shut, and paid threepence.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Called alike no plot, and did not ask a second time for the wife's letter.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Asked which house to pity, and was given the fish instead.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

relations.note: two houses alike is no plot, and she will not rule on a page she has not been given
relations.quote: Alike is no plot. Two houses the same is a street with extra chairs.

story.body: You paid threepence and would not turn the two houses into a story at the board. You did not say a name. You did not open Anne's sheet. You left the King unbegun.

title: Paid threepence and left Anne's sheet in the chest
